Suno – prompt simple (EN, à coller tel quel)

A slow, spacious sci-fi dark ambient cue at 66 BPM in D Phrygian / D minor. Very low-register drones and FM synth pads with slow filter sweeps. A processed bass-register choir pad sustains open-vowel vocalise (ah/oh), pianissimo and blended. Soft bass clarinet and low strings sul tasto. Add sparse damped metallic resonances (bells/plates) and airy high harmonics (glass harmonics), plus filtered noise beds. Minimal, fragmented 2–4 note motifs. Instrumental. Calm, intelligent dread.

Suno – note (V4.5 test) : V4.5 a donné des drones plus imposants; V5 a tendance à lisser.

Exclusion notes (put these in “Exclude styles”, not in the prompt)

Heroic choir, fantasy choir, angelic choir

Suno – prompt avancé (EN, à coller tel quel)

Techno-archaeological sci-fi dark ambient + spectral choir begins at 66 BPM in D Phrygian / D minor: deep sub-bass drones and FM synth pads evolve with slow-moving filter sweeps and long resonances. A heavily processed low bass vocal / bass-register choir layer interlaces with low sul tasto strings in the very low register, creating a slow “heartbeat” pulse. Add filtered noise beds, sparse metal and glass harmonics, and minimal 2–4 note signal motifs to maintain calm, foreboding tension. Loopable core 0:45–2:15. sci-fi dark ambient, spectral choir, cinematic drone, modal, very low register, restrained, spacious, hypnotic

Leçons (à appliquer aux itérations suivantes)

- Décrire des couches sonores et des gestes simples, pas des images.

- Garder l’“alien” via voix grave très traitée / choeur-pad grave, et des motifs-signaux.

- Ancrer “heartbeat/shimmer” dans des mécanismes audio : sub pulses, harmoniques métal/verre.

- Phrygien + FM drones + filtre lent = couleur “ruines SF / techno-archéologie”.

- Tester V4.5 si V5 devient trop sage.

Variantes requises

- Low/Med/High intensity · Instrumental · No percussion · Short loop [30s] · Stinger [1–2s]

Sorties attendues

- WAV master · WAV loop segment · MP3 preview · CUE/JSON loop points · [Stems si dispo]

Intégration

- Event [ex. mus/boss_ensevelie] · Snapshot/Bus [mix/music] · Parameters [intensity 0–1]

- Transitions [expl → boss crossfade 800 ms ; boss → silence 1200 ms]
